class: State initialized only by the main run loop
symptom: Uploading a resume before run raised AttributeError.
root_cause: Upload and entry state existed only after _ensure_state in run.
why_tests_missed: The existing direct-upload tests failed on the base branch and were not enforced before later changes.
fix: Initialize shared state at construction while preserving reload state.
prevention: Every public entry point must work on a freshly constructed agent.
